Hi Anita / Tom,

Thanks again for taking time today - the call was really helpful. Quick recap and the items we discussed so we can keep momentum: 

1) Incident Response & Breach Notification
- You mentioned FintechCorp has a documented IR process and 72-hour breach notification SLA to regulators/customers. Can you confirm: is that 72 hours from detection or from confirmation? Also, does the timeline differ by region (US/EU)?
- We requested a short IR procedure summary and any sample breach notification templates you can share for our compliance review.

2) SOC 2 / Certifications
- You said SOC 2 Type II report is available annually and the latest report is from 2025. Please confirm expected date of next audit and whether the report can be shared under NDA (we can execute if needed).

3) GDPR/HIPAA applicability
- Clarify whether FintechCorp requires HIPAA BAAs for vendors touching PHI, or if you classify payment/transaction data as regulated under narrower scopes.

4) Vendor security questionnaire / procurement
- You mentioned sending an initial security questionnaire (your standard XLS) and that procurement will start a review once we return. Please send the questionnaire and preferred timeline for return.

Next steps (owner / ETA):
- Anita: please confirm the 72-hour definition, attach IR summary + any template (ETA: Thu 10/8)
- Tom / Procurement: send the vendor questionnaire (FintechCorp_Security_Q_2026.xlsx) and ideal return deadline (ETA: Tue 10/12)
- Marissa (cc): I will share the draft PO/quote and the requested product/architecture diagrams if you need them.

Attachments: I have attached a short IR checklist we typically provide to customers (IR_Procedure_Summary.pdf) to help align expectations.

If it's helpful, we can set a 30-min follow-up next week to walk your security/procurement teams through the answers.

Thanks,

Jordan Blake

Thanks Jordan - great to meet you and Marissa on the call. Quick answers and attachments below.

1) IR / Breach notification
- Our SLA is 72 hours from confirmation of a breach (post-triage and validation). We notify regulators per regional rules; EU notifications follow GDPR timelines where applicable.
- Attached: high-level Incident Response Playbook (IR_Playbook_FintechCorp_v3.pdf) and a redacted breach-notification template.

2) SOC 2
- We completed a SOC 2 Type II in Sep 2025. We can share the full report under NDA (we have a standard NDA/Mutual Non-Disclosure form).
- Our next audit window is Q3 2026 (planning).

3) GDPR/HIPAA
- We are HIPAA-aware but only operate on PHI in scoped products; for core payments/transactions we are not processing PHI. If Redwood will handle PHI, we can discuss BAA requirements.

4) Vendor questionnaire
- Attached: FintechCorp_Security_Q_2026.xlsx - procurement would like this back within 7 business days (by Tue 10/12).

Let me know if you want us to loop the SOC2 contact (auditor@securityfirm.com) or legal for the NDA.

Best,
